definition: AWS CloudWatch Monitoring is a core concept in AWS Developer Associate. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What AWS CloudWatch Monitoring is
theory.body: AWS CloudWatch Monitoring describes the methods and patterns used within AWS Developer Associate to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: AWS CloudWatch Monitoring is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why AWS CloudWatch Monitoring matters
theory.body: Without AWS CloudWatch Monitoring, systems built with AWS Developer Associate are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AWS CloudWatch Monitoring works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AWS CloudWatch Monitoring follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of AWS CloudWatch Monitoring.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AWS CloudWatch Monitoring
theory.body: AWS CloudWatch Monitoring offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
